expectation: Membrane CD33 on a minority of myeloid cells (macrophages, myeloid-derived cells) and some DCs. Expect scattered single cells or small clusters, ring-like, in stroma or tumour margins, with most cells negative.
observed: A: many ROIs carry broad yellow haze that varies from saturated to near-empty by ROI, following fibrous or stromal texture. B and C: diffuse grain and speckle, with no ring-shaped cells. D: a wide yellow smear across several nuclei, not a membrane outline.
why: Signal is diffuse haze following tissue texture and ROI-level intensity, with no discrete subset of membrane-stained cells.
notes: Yellow signal is broad and grainy, tracking stroma and whole ROIs rather than a distinct cell subset. B, C and D show no membrane-ringed myeloid cells, so there is no convincing specific population.
